name: Stephen Walsh
headline: Software engineering leader
description: Husband, father and software engineering leader in Neenah, WI. Powered by coffee, haunted by Liverpool, moustached every November. I don't bite… often.
about: Hello! I'm a software engineering leader in Neenah, Wisconsin, by way of Australia. My favourite spot is where leading teams meets staying hands-on in the code: helping engineers grow, building teams that enjoy working together, and still caring about how the software is put together. These days that's at Gradera, where I lead a distributed team delivering a new multi-tenant product, mostly in .NET, and where AI-assisted, spec-driven development is a team practice rather than a personal productivity trick. Now and then I write about engineering, interviews and careers on Medium.

In my spare time I look after Lean Mean Clean Apps, a small family of dotnet new templates that I give away. Away from the keyboard I'm a husband and father first, a long-suffering Liverpool supporter, and usually holding a coffee. Every November I grow a mo and raise money for Movember. The moustache only visits in November, which everyone agrees is for the best. Feel free to say hi, I don't bite… often.

movember.why: I've got more than one reason: my Dad, who won his fight against prostate cancer, my friend Bryan, who's in remission after his, and Derrick and Sean, who went far too soon. If you'd like to help change the face of men's health, every donation counts.

lmca.intro: What I build when the kids are asleep: five dotnet new templates with a low-ceremony take on Clean Architecture. Fewer layers than an onion, more than a sandwich. No investors, no roadmap deck, just a small team (me) having fun and giving it away.
